content.value_statement: Teams can struggle to decide which approved creator assets deserve paid budget and where reuse is permitted. This skill creates a structured amplification or repurposing plan from the campaign data and rights information they provide.
actual_capabilities: Scores approved creator assets for paid amplification using performance, hook, clarity, quality, and CTA criteria.
Builds a paid-media plan covering whitelisting, Spark Ads, boosted posts, dark posts, audiences, budgets, and optimization thresholds.
Creates a rights-tracked inventory for creator assets, including use status and expiration information supplied by the user.
Maps a source video or other approved asset into channel-specific paid, website, email, and organic formats.
Produces a dated 30-day distribution plan and a reusable handoff summary.
Labels missing campaign metrics and rights information instead of presenting estimates as measured facts.
limitations: It does not access advertising platforms, analytics systems, CRM records, or asset libraries by itself.
It requires user-provided campaign metrics, budget, assets, and rights details for accurate recommendations.
It does not approve content for legal, brand, claim, or FTC disclosure compliance.
It provides planning guidance and does not launch campaigns or modify external accounts.

use_cases.title: Prioritize paid creator assets
use_cases.description: Score campaign posts and allocate a fixed paid budget across creators, objectives, and platforms.

use_cases.title: Reuse cleared UGC across channels
use_cases.description: Turn approved videos into an asset inventory, format plan, and 30-day distribution schedule.

use_cases.title: Prepare a rights-aware asset library
use_cases.description: Record rights status and expiry dates before recommending website, email, or paid reuse.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose paid or repurpose mode for three approved creator videos. Explain what information you need first.

prompt_templates.title: Score assets for paid media
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paid mode. Score these five approved TikTok posts using views, engagement rate, hook quality, and CTA. Recommend which to amplify.

prompt_templates.title: Build a repurposing plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use repurpose mode. We have two approved creator videos with paid, website, and email rights. Create a format map and 30-day distribution plan.

prompt_templates.title: Create a budget and optimization plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use paid mode for a $5,000 TikTok and Instagram campaign. Build budget allocations, audience segments, KPI targets, testing steps, and scale or pause thresholds. Mark estimates clearly.

output_examples.input: Score five approved creator videos for a $5,000 campaign.
output: A ranked content scorecard with amplify, consider, and do-not-amplify tiers.
A budget allocation that totals $5,000, plus authorization and testing actions.

output_examples.input: Reuse one approved product-demo video across paid, website, email, and social channels.
output: A rights-aware asset inventory and a map of video, static, quote, and short-form variants.
A dated distribution schedule with channel requirements and outstanding rights checks.

best_practices: Provide measured performance data, campaign objectives, platforms, and total budget before requesting paid recommendations.
Confirm usage rights and expiry dates before planning paid, website, or email reuse.
Treat CPM, ROAS, and similar values as estimates unless you supply a current export.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to publish or approve content for FTC, legal, claim, or brand compliance.
Do not reuse creator assets when usage rights are unknown or expired.
Do not treat planning recommendations as live advertising-platform data or campaign execution.

faq.question: What does paid mode produce?
faq.answer: Paid mode creates a content scorecard, amplification strategy, audience plan, budget allocation, and optimization playbook.

faq.question: What does repurpose mode produce?
faq.answer: Repurpose mode creates a rights-tracked inventory, format map, content library plan, and 30-day distribution plan.

faq.question: Can it connect to my ad account?
faq.answer: No. It works from information you provide and does not access advertising platforms by itself.

faq.question: Does it check legal or FTC compliance?
faq.answer: No. It requires approved content and directs compliance review to the appropriate audit process.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide approved assets, creator and platform details, metrics, rights status, campaign objective, budget, and target channels.

faq.question: Can it recommend reuse when rights are missing?
faq.answer: No. It asks for rights information before recommending paid, website, or email reuse of restricted assets.
